name: context-handoff
description: In the 60-70% context band, Claude writes a handoff, the handoff is rewound away, the session compacts, and Claude resumes from the file.

bandLow.title: Band start (%)
bandLow.description: Context percent at which Claude is told to hand off at the next natural boundary.

bandHigh.title: Band end (%)
bandHigh.description: Context percent at which Claude is told to hand off now.

overshoot.title: Overshoot (%)
overshoot.description: Context percent at which a finished turn with no handoff gets a prompt asking for one.
